subject: Cost and Management Accounting
question_text:
(c)  A company can make any one of the 2 products M or S during the year. It
can exercise its option only at the beginning of each year.

Relevant information about the products for the next year is given below:
Particulars
M
S
Selling Price (` /unit)
75
45
Variable Cost (`/unit)
45
30
Market Demand (in units)
3,000
8,000
Production Capacity (in units)
4,000
7,000
Fixed Cost (`)
1,20,000

You are required to compute the opportunity cost for each of the product.
(3 Marks)
suggested_answer:

Particulars
M
S

30
(75-45)
15
(45-30)

3,000
7,000
III. Possible Contribution (`) {I x II}
90,000

IV. Opportunity Cost (`)
1,05,000
90,000

(*) Opportunity cost is the maximum possible contribution forgone by not
producing alternative products i.e. if product M is produced then opportunity cost
will be ` 1,05,000(Contribution of S).
